question: The M23 rebel group, which has recently advanced in eastern regions such as Goma and Bukavu, is active in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Democratic Republic of Congo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **M23 rebel group**, also known as the **March 23 Movement**, is a rebel military group based in the **Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)**.
 
• The group was formed in **2012** by former members of the National Congress for the Defence of the People (CNDP), a militia that had integrated into the Congolese army as part of a peace deal signed in **2009**.
 
• M23 is active primarily in the **eastern regions** of the Democratic Republic of Congo, including areas like **Goma** and **Bukavu**, which are rich in natural resources but have been plagued by conflict for decades.
